title: Eggless Chocolate Mug Muffin
description: A single-serve chocolate cake made in a mug without eggs. Richer and more brownie-like in texture, ready in about a minute.

method.instruction: In a microwave-safe mug (350-400ml capacity), whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, and baking powder.
Add milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract. Stir with a fork until smooth and fully combined.
Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Microwave on high. For a 1350W microwave, start with 50-60 seconds. The cake should be risen and the top mostly set.
Let stand in the mug for 1 minute before eating to allow carryover cooking to finish the center.

notes.title: Microwave Power
notes.content: Since this version has no egg, it is safe to eat slightly 'underdone'. High-wattage microwaves (1350W) cook significantly faster; avoid going over 60 seconds initially.

notes.title: Big Mug Needed
notes.content: Use a mug that holds at least 350ml. The cake rises significantly during cooking.

notes.title: Dairy-free
notes.content: Substitute full-cream milk with oat or almond milk.
